description: This file contains unit tests for client connection events using Orleans framework, focusing on registered service event notification patterns. It defines test classes, event notifier utilities, configuration setup, and specific test cases to verify connection loss and gateway change events.

classes.name: ClientConnectionRegisteredServiceEventTests
classes.description: Test class for client connection events in Orleans, managing test lifecycle and event subscriptions.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test environment asynchronously, setting up event notifiers.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with custom client builder configurator.

methods.name: EventSendWhenDisconnectedFromCluster
methods.description: Test verifying that a disconnect event is sent when the client is disconnected from the cluster.

methods.name: GatewayChangedEventSentOnDisconnectAndReconnect
methods.description: Test verifying gateway change events are sent on disconnect and reconnect scenarios.

classes.name: EventNotifier<TEventArgs>
classes.description: Generic event notification class supporting subscribe, unsubscribe, and notify operations with thread safety.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds a subscriber callback to the notifier.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscriber callback from the notifier.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Invokes all subscriber callbacks with the given event argument.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client builder by registering event notifiers and event handlers.
